name: instagram-ai-plugin
description: Drive your own Instagram account from the terminal with your browser session (no Graph API app, no Apify): sign in with cookies; read profiles, posts, comments and hashtags; publish photos, carousels, reels and stories, and comment and reply, as approved dry runs; run content, audit, competitor research and ads workflows on real account data; and break down any reel into shots, script and a plan to make your own version.
